#### 1. progressive external ophthalmoplegia with mitochondrial DNA deletions, autosomal dominant 2  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.783)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:10990)

**Proposed mechanism:** SLC25A4 (HGNC:10990) —DISRUPTS→ Mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport (REACT:R-HSA-75170); Mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport (REACT:R-HSA-75170) —LEADS_TO→ Mitochondrial dysfunction (HP:0003212); Mitochondrial dysfunction (HP:0003212) —LEADS_TO→ Progressive external ophthalmoplegia (HP:0009755); Mitochondrial dysfunction (HP:0003212) —LEADS_TO→ Mitochondrial DNA deletion (HP:0003440). Loss-of-function mutations in SLC25A4 disrupt mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport, leading to general mitochondrial dysfunction which manifests as progressive external ophthalmoplegia and mitochondrial DNA deletions.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in SLC25A4 with a gain-of-function mechanism for either disease would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs123456789)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism of SLC25A4 dysfunction provides a target for therapeutic interventions aimed at restoring mitochondrial function or mitigating downstream effects in both diseases.
